question: Do incident reports show the Matrice 30T behaving the way its manual describes after a lost link?

intake.reason: assess whether incident reports show Matrice 30T behaviors described in the manual after loss of control link

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance directs starting emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link and to attempt reestablishing the control link if it is lost. There is no usable evidence from the Matrice 30T manuals. Unverified incident reports describe lost-link behavior with RTH triggered (sometimes within seconds) and back-to-back occurrences, and also separate cases of loss of all control with delayed regain and landing. A forum-like claim mentions live video continuing while stick inputs were unresponsive. Main gap: the degree of link loss ambiguity and whether the reports verify the same control-link behavior described in guidance, with limited evidence on GNSS/Hotpoint status or explicit signal settings.
